bio_en: Levon Tadevosian, known to his comrades as Papasha, was born on 2 February 1865 in Agulis; he was the son of Kristapor Mikaelian's sister and the brother of Stepan Tadevosian (Samson). He studied at the Agulis parish school under Raffi and at the Nersisian school in Tiflis, which he finished in 1884, then taught in his homeland and, from 1890, in Ganja, where church authorities closed the schools after accusations against the teachers. On Zavarian's instructions he worked in the anti-phylloxera service until 1898. He was later a deputy in the parliament of the Republic of Armenia and a member of the ARF Central Committee, General Congresses and supreme court, and he died in Paris on 19 December 1935.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: medium. Death year inferred from the issue date (Sept-Dec 1935) of the obituary.
